_comment: Owner-editable casting sheet for Zone 1 (k26_30). voice_id per speaker x locale is used by --audition; leave it null to skip that line. Values here are never generated automatically and never overwrite canonical dialogue.
casting_status_note: 2026-08-09: zh-TW Messenger recast complete. Owner rejected the original locked casting (Yui, a female voice for a male visual character; never actually male-vs-female auditioned in AUDITION SET A). --audition-set-b produced 3 male candidates (Jun, Zack, Xiaobao); Owner approved Jun - Bright and energetic (5s3UifUu3OJ90z17rRMA). All 8 role x locale slots are locked again. --generate-tts is unblocked.
locking_policy: Once a role x locale slot has "locked": true, no automated tool in this directory (including --audition-set-b) may overwrite its voice_id or candidates without the Owner explicitly unlocking it first. This is enforced in code by cmd_audition_set_b(), not just by convention.
casting_shortlist_source: Claude-analyzed from Owner-provided tools/e10_zone1_audio/_local_review/voices.json (27 ElevenLabs voices: 23 en, 4 zh) for AUDITION SET A. The 3 recast roles' AUDITION SET B candidates came from a live ElevenLabs Voice Library search performed by --audition-set-b on the Owner's machine (this account's personal 27-voice pool was exhausted for zh, and for a genuinely younger en Hero voice) -- see audition_set_b_recast_briefs.json and each role's recast_candidates for the full shortlist and reasoning.

audio_config._comment: Governs which ElevenLabs model --audition/--audition-set-a/--audition-set-b use. --check verifies this model_id exists and supports text-to-speech before any generation is attempted.

recast_candidates.name: Xiaobao
recast_candidates.description: Xiaobao possesses a youthful, vibrant male voice—clear, clean, and energetic—conveying a sincerity and approachability reminiscent of a student. His delivery is natural and fluid; while his pace is brisk, it never feels rushed. His tone is bright and spirited, radiating sunshine, enthusiasm, and positive energy. Skilled at interacting in a relaxed and friendly manner, he is engaging and full of curiosity, coming across like a reliable, lively younger peer or friend. His voice is clean and magnetic—neither forcedly deep nor overly juvenile—reflecting the confidence and authenticity of the younger generation while making the listener feel at ease, relaxed, and hopeful.
